title: Chai Masala
name: Chai Masala Powder
subtitle: A roasted cardamom, clove, pepper and dry ginger blend for masala tea — plus how to brew 2 cups.
protein: A pantry blend — ½ tsp flavours 2 cups of chai

method.title: Roast
items: In a heavy-bottomed pan, take {@cardamom}, {@cloves}, {@pepper}, {@cinnamon} and {@fennel}
Dry roast on a low flame until aromatic; keep aside
Break {@dry-ginger} into pieces and dry roast until aromatic; keep aside
Add {@tulsi} and {@nutmeg} to the pan and roast well

method.title: Grind and store
items: Cool everything completely, then transfer all the spices to a blender
Blend to a slightly coarse powder
Let the powder cool before closing the jar — trapped warmth brings moisture
Store in an airtight container; use within a month

method.label: Toddler note
items: Chai isn't for her — tea has caffeine, and this masala is peppery
Warm her a cup of milk with a pinch of plain ground cardamom instead

method.title: Make 2 cups of chai
items: Boil 4 min, until a strong decoction forms
Add {@milk} and {@sugar}; bring the chai to a boil twice

method.label: Tip
method.text: Keep the roast low and slow — the spices burn quickly and turn bitter. A coarse grind gives the chai more body than a fine powder.
